description: Needs the phone link: the person signs in with the 6-digit code from the Kitchen Timer app (⋯ → Link an agent). List the saved recipes (name, number of steps and timers, whether the cook is part-way through one), or give `recipe` to read one in full: every step with its text and timer, and the step the cook is on right now. Plain meals are not listed here — list_cookbook has those.

recipe.description: Id or name of one recipe to read in full. Omit to list them all.

search.description: When listing: case-insensitive filter on the recipe name.

name: read_recipes

recipe.description: When `recipe` was given: the whole recipe, with `steps` and `cook` (the step the cook is on, or null).

recipes.description: When listing: the recipes, most-recently-used first.

warnings.description: Things worth saying out loud that are not failures.

title: List or read recipes
